details.invariant: empty or out-of-bounds evidence does not verify
details.observed: 5 empty or out-of-bounds records fail; a true one passes

details.observed: contradicting RCT fails; guideline context and animal data warn; supporting human RCT passes

details.invariant: agents read a frozen state and cannot emit above their principal

details.invariant: a state changed behind the log is detected and restored

details.invariant: a report presents only hypotheses judged on their current version

notes: Each invariant is a probe run against the harness under evaluation; the unit tests (tests/test_boundaries.py) check the same boundaries on the default harness.

details.text: 太阳病，头痛，发热，汗出，恶风，桂枝汤主之。

阳胜则热，阴胜则寒。

诸风掉眩，皆属于肝。
脉浮者，病在表，可发汗，宜麻黄汤。
腹满时痛，此太阴病也，寒湿所致。

痞满燥实俱见者，然后可下，宜大承气汤。

因于寒，欲如运枢。

夫五脏六腑皆令人咳，非独肺也。
